description: This Java class 'HttpUrl' acts as a wrapper around the URL class to facilitate mocking HTTP URL calls. It provides a constructor that validates and initializes the URL, and a method to open an HTTP connection.

classes.name: HttpUrl
classes.description: A wrapper class around Java's URL to abstract away direct URL handling and enable mocking for HTTP calls.

methods.name: HttpUrl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HttpUrl object with a given URL string, validating it to be non-null and starting with http or https.

methods.name: openConnection
methods.description: Opens and returns an HttpURLConnection for the wrapped URL.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the wrapped URL.
